name: IconButton
description: A round or square icon-only button with a floating label that springs in on hover or keyboard focus and a ripple that expands from the exact press point. Comes with solid, soft, outline and ghost variants and seven built-in inline icons.
a11yNotes: Native <button> with `label` as its aria-label, so the icon-only control always has an accessible name. The floating label is a visual duplicate (aria-hidden) shown on hover and :focus-visible. Ripples also fire for Enter/Space presses and are aria-hidden. Under prefers-reduced-motion ripples, hover tilt and press scale are disabled.

propsApi.name: label
propsApi.description: Accessible name, also shown as the floating hover/focus label.

propsApi.name: children
propsApi.description: Custom icon that replaces the built-in one.

propsApi.name: showLabel
propsApi.description: Show the floating label on hover and keyboard focus.

propsApi.name: labelSide
propsApi.description: Side the floating label appears on.

propsApi.name: ripple
propsApi.description: Expand a ripple from the press point.

propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root wrapper.

propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root wrapper.
